Create stand file for virtual forest stand based on the 3D-CMCC_FEM model simulation

Source: R/virtual_stand_generator.R
virtual_stand_generator.Rd

virtual_stand_generator launches the run_3DCMCCFEM function to simulate the development of the forest over time. One or more stand files corresponding to the age classes specified by the user with the stand_age parameter are generated from the simulation output.

Usage

virtual_stand_generator(
  site = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  stand_age,
  co2 = "on",
  man = NULL,
  pres_dens = NULL,
  after_pres = NULL,
  reg = "off",
  year_start_man = -9999,
  rep_trees = -9999,
  rep_age = -9999,
  rep_dbh = -9999,
  rep_lai = -9999,
  rep_height = -9999,
  rep_species = -9999,
  reg_trees = -9999,
  reg_age = -9999,
  reg_dbh = -9999,
  reg_lai = -9999,
  reg_height = -9999,
  co2_conc = 368.865,
  frac_maxasw = 1,
  cell = 100,
  pruning = "off",
  irrigation = "off",
  inputdir = NULL,
  outputdir = NULL
)

Arguments

site

Character: Site name. Used to construct output name

species

Character: Species names (same as parameterization files)

stand_age

Numeric vector: age of the output virtual stands

co2

Character: CO2 concentration changes according to scenario; options: c("on","off","var")

man

Character: Management options; options: c("on","off","var")

pres_dens

Character: Prescribed densities in stand file if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

after_pres

Character: Management after last year of prescribed density if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

reg

Character: Regeneration; options: c("on","off")

year_start_man

Integer: If man = "on"; Starting year of management; Default to -9999.

rep_trees, rep_age, rep_dbh, rep_lai, rep_height, rep_species

Replanting parameters (number of trees, age, average DBH, LAI, height and species). Default to -9999.

reg_trees

Integer: Number of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_age

Integer: Age of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_dbh

Integer: Average DBH of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_lai

Integer: Average LAI of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_height

Integer: Average height of saplings; Default to -9999.

co2_conc

Numeric: Concentration of CO2 if co2 = "off"; Default to 368.865

frac_maxasw

Numeric: Percentage of water content in soil compared to maximum at the beginning of simulation (1 = 100%); Default to 1

cell

Numeric: Size of the cell; Default to 100 (1 ha)

pruning

Character: Do pruning be performed? options: c("on","off"); Default to "off"

irrigation

Character: Do irrigation be performed? options: c("on","off"); Default to "off"

inputdir

Character: Path to input files directory

outputdir

Character: Path to output files directory. If it is not named 'output', a subdirectory 'output' is created.

Value

Used for its side effects. It saves in outputdir/virtual_stand a site_age_stand.txt file with stand charateristics and returns invisibly the virtual stands. For all details of the stand file please refer to the User's Guide

Details

As the run_3DCMCCFEM function, the virtual_stand_generator function need at least 6 input .txt files, that must be in the same directory and should be named according to the name of the site or the species: "site_stand.txt", "site_soil.txt", "site_topo.txt", "site_meteo.txt", "site_co2.txt", "species.txt". A "site_management.txt" file must be provided if required. Usually meteo and co2 files are de-trended climate data make with the make_CCS function. The simulation starts from the first year of the stand file and ends with the last year of the meteo file. If the stand age of the virtual stand is not present in the simulation, a warning is throw and the user need to set the appropriate replanting parameters (man=on; year_start_man and all rep_* arguments). See the model specification for the correct use of replanting. This function can be used to create stand files for forest age classes for which there are no data.
